msg: Control flow of non-void function ends here!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 242f1a34377.c (Linux crypto). 'Control flow of non-void function ends here!' at line 15 (main), when !def(CONFIG_CRYPTO_TEST). When CRYPTO_TEST=false, main() is an empty body with no test_cipher() call and no return statement. Same analysis as FAMILY_18: in C99, falling off the end of main() is equivalent to returning 0 — this is not a real bug. The alarm is a false positive from applying a non-void function rule to main().
